repos.description: Open-source gym & body-weight tracker, now in the App Store (iPhone + Apple Watch) and as an Android APK. Plan routines, log workouts, see which muscles are trained, import from Strong/Hevy/FitNotes. Self-host it or use it on the phone alone.
repos.summary_zh: openGym 是一款自托管健身与体重追踪应用，支持训练计划、组数记录、肌肉疲劳分析、跨设备同步与 Passkey 登录。数据完全由用户掌控，支持从 FitNotes/Strong/Hevy 导入，提供 Android APK 与 Web 端，是隐私优先的开源健身管理方案。
repos.summary_en: openGym is a self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker that lets you plan weekly routines, log every set including supersets, warm-ups, and cardio, and visualize which muscles are trained, fatigued, or detrained. It supports cross-device sync, passkey login, and data import from FitNotes, Strong, and Hevy. Your data stays on your own server, giving you full ownership and privacy. Available as a web app and Android APK, it's a privacy-first, open-source alternative to commercial fitness subscriptions, with stats dashboards featuring heatmaps, charts, and personal records.

repos.description: 📱 Display and control your Android device graphically with scrcpy.
repos.summary_zh: Escrcpy 是基于 scrcpy 的跨平台 Android 设备图形化管控工具。通过 Electron 封装提供直观界面，支持多设备并行管理与可视化窗口编排。核心亮点包括集成 AutoGLM 实现自然语言智能控制、自动化工作流执行，以及 Gnirehtet 反向网络共享。适用于移动开发测试、批量设备操作等场景，提供低延迟、高性能的屏幕镜像体验。
repos.summary_en: Escrcpy is a cross-platform Android device management tool built on scrcpy. It provides an intuitive Electron-based GUI for mirroring and controlling Android devices with low latency. Key features include multi-device orchestration, natural language control via AutoGLM AI, automated workflow execution, and wireless connectivity with Gnirehtet reverse tethering. Ideal for mobile development, testing, and batch device operations.

repos.description: 🤖 A minimal and customizable Docker image running the Android emulator as a service.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供基于Alpine的最小化Docker镜像，用于将Android模拟器作为服务运行。支持KVM硬件加速和GPU加速（CUDA），可自定义Android版本与设备类型，内置ADB端口转发，兼容scrcpy远程控屏。专为CI/CD农场设计，提供无头运行模式，镜像体积可压缩至138MB（不含SDK），适用于自动化测试与远程Android开发场景。
repos.summary_en: Repository provides a minimal Alpine-based Docker image that runs Android emulator as a service. Features KVM hardware acceleration and GPU support (CUDA), customizable Android versions/device types, built-in ADB port forwarding, and scrcpy compatibility for remote screen control. Designed for headless CI/CD farms, the image can be compressed to 138MB (SDK-free variant). Ideal for automated testing and remote Android development with optimized performance and network accessibility.

repos.description: The most full featured web-to-app toolkit on Android, a complete APK workshop that runs entirely on your phone
repos.summary_zh: WebToApp 是一款运行在 Android 手机上的完整 APK 构建工具，可将 Web 项目直接打包为原生应用。无需 PC 或远程服务器，支持执行服务端运行时、签名 Google Play 包、运行 MV3 浏览器扩展，并内置抗审查网络栈，是移动端开发者的离线构建利器。
repos.summary_en: WebToApp is a full-featured on-device Android APK builder that converts web projects into native apps directly on your phone. It supports server runtime execution, Google Play signing, MV3 browser extensions, and an anti-censorship network stack — no PC or remote server required.

repos.description: An Xposed module to intercept applist detections
repos.summary_zh: 基于Xposed框架的Android隐私保护模块，通过拦截应用列表请求隐藏已安装应用，防止其他应用检测Root工具来识别设备Root状态，同时抵御基于应用列表的指纹追踪，并提供隐藏效果验证功能。
repos.summary_en: An Xposed module for Android that intercepts app list requests to hide installed applications from other apps. It prevents apps from detecting root-related tools (such as Fake Location or Storage Isolation) that would reveal a device is rooted. Additionally, it blocks apps from using app list enumeration as fingerprinting data or for other nefarious purposes. The module also provides built-in verification methods to test whether app list hiding is working properly, ensuring comprehensive privacy protection on rooted Android devices.

repos.description: Open-source compatibility layer for Diablo II: Resurrected with the Reign of the Warlock expansion. Runs your own Switch copy natively on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and HarmonyOS — full touch controls, 60 fps, new endgame modes. Bring your own game files. 开源的《暗黑破坏神 II：狱火重生》术士君临 iOS / macOS / 安卓 / 鸿蒙兼容层
repos.summary_zh: 开源的《暗黑破坏神 II：狱火重生》iOS/macOS 兼容层，将 Switch 版游戏原生移植至 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac。基于 aarch64 原生执行与 Metal 图形重实现，支持术士君临扩展、完整触控操作、60fps 流畅运行，用户自备游戏文件即可离线畅玩。
repos.summary_en: Open-source iOS/macOS compatibility layer for Diablo II: Resurrected with Reign of the Warlock. Runs the Switch build natively on Apple devices via aarch64 execution and Metal graphics reimplementation, with full touch controls and 60 fps.

repos.description: 高颜值第三方 B 站 React Native 客户端
repos.summary_zh: JKVideo 是一款基于 React Native 和 Expo 构建的高颜值第三方 B 站客户端，支持 Android、iOS 和 Web 三端。核心亮点包括完整的 DASH 视频播放系统（4K HDR）、实时弹幕同步、纯 TypeScript 实现的 WBI 签名算法，以及 Zustand 状态管理。提供扫码登录、下载管理和局域网分享功能，是跨平台视频应用开发的优秀实践。
repos.summary_en: JKVideo is a high-quality third-party Bilibili client built with React Native and Expo, supporting Android, iOS, and Web platforms. Key features include complete DASH video playback (4K HDR), real-time danmaku synchronization, pure TypeScript WBI signing algorithm, and Zustand state management. It offers QR code login, download management, and LAN sharing capabilities, serving as an excellent example of cross-platform video application development.

repos.description: Medium Unlocker (now Freedium App) is an android app designed to access Medium, NYT, Bloomberg, Washington Post, Financial Times, Reuters, The Economist articles without any paywalls.
repos.summary_zh: Freedium（原Medium Unlocker）是一款Android原生应用，基于Java+WebView实现，支持通过Freedium与Archive.is镜像无障碍阅读Medium、纽约时报、华盛顿邮报、彭博、路透社、经济学人及金融时报文章。提供分享接收、深度链接、镜像自动切换、历史书签、阅读位置记忆、Markdown复制及离线友好功能，解决多订阅墙痛点。
repos.summary_en: Freedium (formerly Medium Unlocker) is a native Android app built with Java and WebView that unlocks paywalled articles from Medium, NYT, Washington Post, Bloomberg, Reuters, The Economist and Financial Times via Freedium and Archive.is mirrors. It offers share-sheet integration, deep links, auto-fallback mirrors, history, bookmarks, scroll memory, Markdown export and offline-friendly reading for casual multi-publisher access.

repos.description: Run OpenClaw on Android with a single command — no proot, no Linux
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过仅安装glibc动态链接器（ld.so）替代传统proot-distro方案，实现OpenClaw在Android/Termux上的一键部署，存储开销从1-2GB降至约200MB，并提供独立APK应用，无需完整Linux发行版即可运行Node.js应用。
repos.summary_en: Runs OpenClaw on Android/Termux using only glibc ld.so, eliminating proot-distro. Cuts storage from 1-2GB to ~200MB with one-command setup and a standalone APK app.

repos.description: Run OpenClaw AI Gateway on Android — standalone Flutter app with built-in terminal, web dashboard, and one-tap setup. Also available as a Termux CLI package.
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw 将 OpenClaw AI 网关移植到 Android 平台，提供免 root 的 Flutter 独立应用和 Termux CLI 两种模式。通过 proot 技术自动构建 Ubuntu 环境并安装 Node.js 22 和 OpenClaw，实现一键部署。应用内置终端模拟器、Web 管理面板、实时日志查看和网关启停控制，支持 API 密钥配置和后台常驻服务。可选安装 Go 和 Homebrew 开发工具，让 Android 设备成为便携的 AI 网关节点。
repos.summary_en: OpenClaw brings the OpenClaw AI Gateway to Android via a standalone Flutter app and Termux CLI package. It uses proot to automatically set up an Ubuntu environment with Node.js 22 and OpenClaw, requiring no root access. The app features a built-in terminal emulator, embedded web dashboard, real-time log viewer, and gateway controls. It supports one-tap deployment, API key configuration, background foreground service, and optional installation of Go and Homebrew tools, turning Android devices into portable AI gateway nodes.

repos.description: Use your android phone as windows virtual webcam
repos.summary_zh: VCamdroid 将 Android 手机摄像头转化为 Windows 高性能虚拟摄像头。通过 Softcam 的 DirectShow 滤镜实现与 Zoom、OBS、Teams 等应用的无缝兼容，支持 ADB 有线和 Wi-Fi 无线连接，采用 RTSP 协议、Camera2 API、OpenGL 预处理及硬件编码（H.264/HEVC），提供低延迟视频流。支持多设备切换、相机控制（前后摄、分辨率、闪光灯）及实时图像调整（旋转、翻转、亮度等），适用于视频会议、直播和录制场景。
repos.summary_en: VCamdroid turns your Android phone's camera into a high-performance virtual webcam for Windows. It uses a custom DirectShow filter from the Softcam library for seamless compatibility with Zoom, OBS, Discord, and Teams. Supporting both ADB wired and Wi-Fi wireless connections via RTSP, it delivers low-latency, hardware-accelerated streams using Camera2 API, OpenGL preprocessing, and MediaCodec encoding. Features include multi-device support, full camera controls, and real-time image adjustments, ideal for video calls, streaming, and recording.

repos.description: 基于 LSPosed 框架的 Android 系统级虚拟定位与环境伪装模块。Fakelocation module based on LSPosed which is available to GMS.
repos.summary_zh: Shadow是一款基于LSPosed框架的Android系统级虚拟定位与环境伪装模块。通过底层Hook系统服务与高德/腾讯地图SDK，实现GPS、基站、Wi-Fi的全维度位置模拟及指纹伪造，支持防跳回与GMS兼容。核心价值在于比传统Mock Location更强的隐蔽性，适用于隐私保护、应用测试与位置模拟场景，技术亮点为系统层劫持与随机环境生成。
repos.summary_en: Shadow is an LSPosed-based Android module for system-level virtual location and environment spoofing. It hooks system services and map SDKs (Gaode/Tencent) to fake GPS, cell info, and Wi-Fi lists with anti-rebound features and GMS compatibility. Core value lies in superior stealth over traditional mock location via low-level file interactions. Ideal for privacy protection and app testing, with highlights in system-layer hooking and random fingerprint generation.
